description: This file provides helper functions for handling glyphs and code points within fonts, specifically for PDF processing within the PDFsharp library. It includes methods for obtaining glyph indices from code points and strings, and handles different font encoding types.

classes.name: GlyphHelper
classes.description: A static helper class providing methods to map Unicode code points and strings to glyph indices for font rendering.

methods.name: GlyphIndexFromCodePoint
methods.description: Returns the glyph ID for the specified Unicode code point, or 0 if the font does not contain a glyph for it.

methods.name: GlyphIndicesFromString
methods.description: Converts a string into an array of glyph indices using the specified font.

methods.name: CodepointsFromStringUsingRunes
methods.description: Converts a string into an array of Unicode code points using runes (not standard in .NET Framework/Standard).
